ResearchProjectDef.label: neutroamine synthesizer kludging
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work out how to patch a wrecked neutroamine synthesizer back into crude service. Needs a wrecked neutroamine synthesizer that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the kludge on the wrecked neutroamine synthesizer where it stands.

ResearchProjectDef.label: neutroamine synthesizer refurbishment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to bring a kludged neutroamine synthesizer close to what it was. This is not the original engineering, which its makers already solved. It is the colony's own hard-won knowledge of how to bring a dead one back. Needs a kludged neutroamine synthesizer that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the refurbishment on the kludged neutroamine synthesizer where it stands. It needs an ancient component.
